description: Use this when the signed-in owner asks when THEIR posts should go out or what time works best for their own account. Returns the time Suara posts for them and what it rests on: their own Instagram results when there's enough history, otherwise the time they chose or a study for their kind of business, said plainly. Read only. For a city's general best times use best_time_to_post.
name: my_best_times
